summary: Tests whether neural and behavioral temporal dynamics covary across sessions by estimating and correlating their inverse decay constants.
use_when: correlate neural and behavioral decay constants across sessions
estimate inverse timescales from neural latent dynamics
compare neural autocorrelation decay with behavioral dwell times
plot session-level neural versus behavioral decay rates
test coupling between brain and behavioral timescales
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
